business_problem: Support operations dashboard data can silently mix duplicate ticket facts, missing routing metadata, refund-like negative amounts, and extreme outliers before publication.

issue_categories.name: Duplicate ticket identity
issue_categories.risk: Dashboards can double-count a support case or attach remediation to the wrong row.

issue_categories.evidence: 2 required routing fields missing across priority/team checks.
issue_categories.name: Missing routing metadata
issue_categories.risk: Support operations cannot reliably route or prioritize every ticket.

issue_categories.name: Negative customer-impact amount
issue_categories.risk: Refund-like events are mixed into positive customer-impact facts.

issue_categories.name: Extreme amount outlier
issue_categories.risk: Extreme values can skew reporting and need review before publication.

not_claimed: No customer production deployment is claimed.
This artifact measures a reproducible business-data case study, not enterprise adoption.
resume_safe_summary: Quantified 4 support-ticket data quality issue categories across 8 rows, including duplicate ticket IDs, missing routing fields, negative amounts, and amount outliers.
